name: CM262 EO/IR/SWIR gimbal (CACI)
description: Four-sensor 16 kg gimbal on the L-MADIS sensor vehicle: HD EO, HD MWIR, SWIR and a laser rangefinder, 360 deg continuous in azimuth and +90 to -16 deg in elevation, with on-board C-UAS tracking. CACI publishes no detection or identification range against any target, so the ring is REPRESENTATIVE. The datasheet's 16 km is the laser rangefinder's ranging range, not a detection range.

classifyRangeM.condition: identification range — REPRESENTATIVE, set equal to detectRangeM. Basis: this gimbal's role in L-MADIS is visual identification on a radar cue, so the detection event and the identification event are the same event. Matches the convention used for lib-wisp.
classifyRangeM.source: CACI, 'CM262 ground system - Multi-mission ISR and C-sUAS' datasheet (PDF), linked from https://www.caci.com/eo-ir-imaging-systems
classifyRangeM.note: Inventory records 5000 m at UNKNOWN REPRESENTATIVE; the seed leaves the field null

sectorDeg.source: CACI CM262 ground system datasheet (FS576a, 2026), Widen DAM PDF

elevationDeg.source: CACI CM262 ground system datasheet (FS576a, 2026), Widen DAM PDF

rangeAccuracyM.note: Planning factor: a laser rangefinder is fitted; eyesafe 1.54 µm rangefinders in this class are specified at ±2 to ±5 m and no figure is published for this unit, so 5 m is recorded.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.source: CACI CM262 datasheet 3-2-0, gimbal position accuracy 0.0046° (80 µrad), quoted from the search index; the PDF was blocked on read

elevationAccuracyDeg.source: CACI CM262 datasheet 3-2-0, gimbal position accuracy 0.0046° (80 µrad), quoted from the search index; the PDF was blocked on read

pixelPitchUm.note: Planning factor: the FS576a sheet names no detector. Its own MWIR figures (300 mm tele, 2.4° HFOV, 1280 px) imply 300 × tan(2.4°) / 1280 = 9.8 µm, and HD 1280-class MWIR cores are made at 10 µm (Lynred Daphnis-HD MW, 10 µm); recorded as 10 µm.

focalLengthMm.condition: MWIR channel, tele end of the 15 to 300 mm focal length range
focalLengthMm.source: CACI CM262 ground system datasheet (FS576a, 2026), Widen DAM PDF

detectorPixelsH.source: CACI CM262 ground system datasheet (FS576a, 2026), Widen DAM PDF

fovDeg.source: CACI CM262 ground system datasheet (FS576a, 2026), Widen DAM PDF

mrtdMk.note: Planning factor: CACI publishes no MRTD or NETD. Cooled HD MWIR cores publish NETD of 20 mK (Lynred Daphnis-HD MW), <25 mK (Teledyne FLIR Neutrino SX12) and <30 mK (DRS HexaBlu 1280-MW); the 25 mK median is used as the low-spatial-frequency MRTD.

eoBand.value: dual: HD EO, HD MWIR, SWIR and a laser rangefinder
eoBand.source: CACI CM262 ground system datasheet (FS576a, 2026), Widen DAM PDF
